name: inner
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::inner(Tensor self, Tensor other) -> Tensor. Computes the generalized inner product by contracting the final dimension of both operands. The correctness suite covers scalar, vector dot-product, matrix/vector, matrix/matrix, batched leading dimensions, zero-length contractions, noncontiguous inputs, dtype mismatch, contraction mismatch, and floating-point accumulation accuracy. The operation does not mutate or alias either input.
